title: arctostaphylos glandulosa var. zacaensis
intro: Arctostaphylos glandulosa var. zacaensis, commonly known as the Zaca manzanita, is a variety of the manzanita plant species, which is a type of flowering plant in the heath family (Ericaceae). The health benefits of the Zaca manzanita include its potential to support immune function and protect against oxidative stress due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may be beneficial in wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of the Zaca manzanita include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
